standard_prerequisites.name: Topology of Proj
standard_prerequisites.use: Standard opens form a basis, and D_+(f_i) cover Proj(S) exactly when S_+ sits in the radical of the ideal generated by the f_i.

core_obligations: If S_+ sits in the radical of (f_1, ..., f_n) with f_i homogeneous of positive degree, the standard opens D_+(f_i) cover Proj(S).
Conversely, if Proj(S) is quasi-compact, the standard-open basis gives a finite subcover D_+(f_i), and the same lemma forces S_+ into the radical of (f_1, ..., f_n).
proof_roadmap: Forward: cover by the standard opens; backward: extract a finite subcover from the basis and read the radical inclusion.
difficulty_reason: Two-direction argument, both routed through the topology lemma on standard opens; fully displayed.
